# Assembly / modelling notes
* STEP part files carry no assembly positions, so the layout is rebuilt from the measurement table and the circle
  centres inside `track__updated.step` (sprocket axle at the origin, rollers at x = +/-153 mm, 103.5 mm lower).
* Visual meshes in `tracked_robot_description/meshes/visual` are generated by `scripts/generate_meshes.py`
  (binary STL, metres). To use real CAD: export decimated STL (<~30k triangles) with the same file name, same origin
  (axle centre; spin axis = Y; belt profile in X-Z, width along Y), and the same scale (metres).
* Real outstanding unknowns: chassis box height (16 cm assumed), mass split, motor gearing, front/back track offsets.
